time.expression: Scaled-dual log₂ cost ≈ [2L/(2L+1)] · (unscaled-dual log₂ cost), in the stated sparse-FHE regime

space.expression: Depends on the chosen dual-lattice solver.

notes: A relative improvement in the source’s fixed-width sparse-FHE regime q=n^L·2^{O(L)}. It is not a universal exponent for LWE and need not beat exhaustive sparse-secret search when h is constant.

extra.parameters: q(n) with log₂q=L log₂n+O(L), fixed L>0, constant Gaussian width αq=8 and fixed sparse weight h (source example h=64); source scaled dimension m′=2n.
extra.noise: Discrete Gaussian width αq=8, i.e. standard deviation 8/√(2π), independent of n.
extra.secret: Uniform sparse ternary secret of fixed Hamming weight h, as in the source’s HElib asymptotic model.
extra.samples: Enough samples for the selected dual-lattice dimension; actual m must be enforced when instantiating.
extra.objective: Decision-LWE under a scaled dual-lattice attack.
extra.model: Relative exponent scaling 2L/(2L+1) against the corresponding unscaled dual model.
extra.assumptions: Source lattice-reduction and small-secret scaling model; fixed h and L are essential.
extra.success: Use the same target distinguishing advantage in both compared dual cost models.

evidence.locator: Abstract and Section Modulus switching / asymptotic behaviour
evidence.sourceVersion: Author TeX commit 2fc91ddbe45e21d7c337bfc658e4fd8926dd887c, 18 May 2017; associated ePrint last revised 6 May 2017

space.expression: Space of the reduced-dimension solver C.

notes: Exploits the event that a discarded coordinate subset misses the sparse support. C denotes a specified residual LWE solver, so this is a reduction/tradeoff rather than a standalone universal LWE exponent.

extra.parameters: Fix h≥0 and d>1 independent of n; p_{h,d}=lim_{n→∞}binom(n−h,n/d)/binom(n,n/d)=(1−1/d)^h.
extra.noise: Original error distribution/width αq is retained by the zero-support branch.
extra.secret: Uniform support of Hamming weight h with small ternary nonzero values; basic support argument does not depend on their magnitudes.
extra.samples: Same original sample budget passed to residual instances; residual solver requirements remain explicit.
extra.objective: Solve LWE using independent support-avoidance trials and a residual solver C.
extra.model: C(N,α,q) is cost at the fixed required high success probability; d=2 gives p=2^{−h}.
extra.assumptions: Uniform/random sparse support; high-success residual solver; fixed h,d.
extra.success: Constant support-avoidance probability per trial, amplified by O(1/p_{h,d}) trials.
